title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Priya Nair
description: This PR adds a set of RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and corresponding quickstart pages for the docs site. Motivation: reduce onboarding time for developers integrating agents with external tools and demonstrate common RAG patterns and safe tool invocation. Includes three opinionated agent templates (qa-assistant, ticket-triage, code-searcher), two tool-calling examples (calendar and ticketing API adapters) with sample request/response contracts, and docs site quickstarts that walk through running the examples locally and on Redwood Hosted API. Also updates the examples repository and links in the docs sidebar.
commits: feat(rag): add qa-assistant and ticket-triage agent templates
feat(examples): add tool adapters for calendar and ticketing APIs with mock servers
docs(site): add quickstarts, screenshots, and sidebar links; update navigation
discussion: Alex Chen: Please add a short security note about validating tool responses. Author (Priya): Added validation section to examples and unit tests that assert adapter contracts. Marta: Can we include a non-PSK auth example for ticketing? Author: Added optional OAuth flow and documented env var usage. Liam: Tests failing on CI due to flakiness in mock server startup on linux runners. Author: Increased startup timeout and added healthcheck; re-ran CI and all checks passed. Final approvals from Alex and Marta before merge.
release_notes: Added RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to help developers get started with agents and safe tool integration. Includes examples for calendar and ticketing adapters and docs site quickstarts.
